title.value: GrowSpace: Learning How to Shape Plants
title.justification: The exact title provided at the beginning of the paper.
title.quote: GrowSpace: Learning How to Shape Plants

extractions.description: This paper introduces GrowSpace, a reinforcement learning (RL) environment designed to model and control plant growth by simulating a plant's response to light stimuli. GrowSpace challenges include controlling plant shape, hierarchical learning, and multi-objective learning. The paper discusses the RL framework applied to plant response, utilizing the Space Colonisation Algorithm to simulate plant growth, and experiments demonstrating the challenges presented by GrowSpace for RL algorithms. The paper highlights its potential applications in agricultural plant science and RL research.

climate_change_is_central.justification: While the paper focuses on plant growth and uses RL to simulate this in a controlled environment, it does not specifically address climate change or related issues such as carbon sequestration, reducing greenhouse gases, or sustainable agriculture practices.
climate_change_is_central.quote: This benchmark is based on real plant responses to light and leverages this response to address a set of diverse challenges that are beyond the scope of bio-engineering. We bring attention to a set of four different challenges that range from classic control to fairness.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not focus on any climate change-specific topics or directly contribute to climate change mitigation, adaptation, or understanding. Instead, it addresses reinforcement learning and plant growth modeling, which are not captured by the current climate change-related categories.
primary_category.quote: We propose GrowSpace, as a new RL benchmark...compared to video game RL environments, this simulator addresses a real-world problem and serves as a test bed to visualize plant growth and movement in a faster way than physical experiments.

secondary_categories.justification: The closest indirect application could be related to agriculture in a broader sense, potentially contributing to understanding plant growth that may influence future climate-smart agricultural practices.
secondary_categories.quote: We direct our interest on plants, which similarly to robots, need to interact with their environment. Plants are complex and sense their surroundings through actuation and sensing systems.

primary_sub_category.justification: The content of the paper does not align specifically with any sub-category of climate change concerns but rather focuses on plant growth and reinforcement learning applications.
primary_sub_category.quote: We argue that plant responses to an environmental stimulus are a good example of a real-world problem that can be approached within a reinforcement learning (RL) framework.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: While not directly related to climate change, understanding plant response and control could eventually support agricultural practices, which is part of climate change mitigation efforts.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: The RL community needs new simulation-driven benchmark environments with real-world properties. Currently there are a limited number of benchmarks that represent real-world systems since they are hard to design and learning from the physical world is difficult.

applications.value: Modeling and controlling plant growth with reinforcement learning in simulated environments.
applications.justification: The paper focus is on plant modeling and using RL to simulate plant growth control through light stimuli.
applications.quote: The primary contributions of this paper include: (i) GrowSpace1 , an OpenAI Gym-compatible environment [5] for RL, agricultural plant science, and robotics research...

new_primary_category.value: Reinforcement Learning Applications in Plant Sciences
new_primary_category.justification: The paper primarily discusses the application of reinforcement learning in simulating plant growth, an area not directly covered by existing climate change categories.
new_primary_category.quote: With the objective of controlling a plant by moving the light source, we propose GrowSpace, as a new RL benchmark.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: While the paper is innovative in the context of plant modeling and growth, it doesn't necessitate creation of a new sub-category within the climate change context.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: We provide agent baselines alongside case studies to demonstrate the difficulty of the proposed benchmark.
